items.prompt: Mientras (yo) ___ la cena, sonó el teléfono. (preparar)
items.explanation: The action in progress is in the imperfect; the event that interrupts it is in the preterite.
optionNotes: The cooking was in progress when the phone rang: imperfect.
The present perfect does not describe an action in progress.

items.prompt: Ayer ___ a mi profesora en el supermercado. (ver)
items.explanation: One finished action yesterday: preterite. Ver is vi, without an accent.
optionNotes: Veía describes a habit or a background, not one event.
Ayer is a finished time: preterite, not the present perfect.

items.prompt: Cuando era niño, ___ a la playa todos los veranos.
items.explanation: Todos los veranos is a repeated habit in the past: imperfect, iba.
optionNotes: A repeated habit takes the imperfect, not the preterite.
Fue is for él, ella, usted, and it is the preterite.

items.prompt: ___ las diez cuando llegamos al hotel.
items.explanation: The time is the background of the event: imperfect, eran.
optionNotes: The time is a background, so it takes the imperfect.
The time is told with ser, not estar.
